workshops_collaborative_research.title: The Making of Publicness Workshop
workshops_collaborative_research.host_or_conductor: Bengal Institute; conducted by Arfar Razi
details: Investigated two sites in Dhaka through spatial, political, and physical analysis.
Conducted user-based assessments on comfort, perception, inclusivity, vitality, and likability; produced a video documentary presenting findings and narratives.
Workshop inspired by a course developed by Bjorn Sletto and conducted by a UT Austin MCRP graduate.
